messages:
Jorge (CS): FYI SentinelCare wants to onboard a compact 7B summarizer for ER intake routing. Private deployment + cloud HSM required, and theyare a lot about PHI redaction. They flagged contract renewal if we can't meet SLA.
Nina (Solutions): Compact 7B ok. Are they providing a quantized artifact or raw fp16 checkpoint? Also need expected QPS/concurrency.
Jorge (CS): They're sending fp16 + a small INT8 candidate. Peak 6 QPS, usually 1-2. Concurrency target 4.
Omar (SRE): Two clarifications: (1) target p95 latency? (2) do they want synchronous sync calls or async batch queue?
Jorge (CS): They want p95 < 180ms for 128-token summaries at 99% of traffic. Prefer sync.
Lina (Enablement): We'll run a customer enablement: console walk-through, incident playbook, SLA expectations, and fallback to async queue. When do they want training?
Quinn (Safety): We'll run the PHI-redaction probe and prompt-injection checks. Need their validation set (representative prompts + edge cases).
Nina (Solutions): Ask them for a 200-sample prompt set + 1k throughput-style latency file. We'll bench on 80GB A100 and also an 80GB L40.
Jorge (CS): Sending request to SentinelCare PM (Leah) now. Also they asked about key management: prefer cloud HSM with rotation & customer-controlled keys.
infra-bot: Note: create security review ticket SEC-13121 for PHI model onboarding. Document required: Data Processing Addendum + HSM access form.
Omar (SRE): Proposed rollout: canary on Dedicated with 1 node, KV cache enabled, autoscale to 2 nodes if p95 > 200ms consistently. Fallback to int8 variant if latency spikes. We'll need memory footprint estimate.
Nina (Solutions): Quick config we'd request from their infra team:
```
serve_config:
  max_length: 2048
  kv_cache: true
  prefer_quantized: true
  batch_size_hint: 2
```
Please supply memory and tokenizer details.
Quinn (Safety): For the evals we'll run: PHI-leakage probe, hallucination regression, and label-inference. Need a copy of the fine-tune dataset OR sample slices for review.
Lina (Enablement): I'll prepare the enablement invite for next Tue and record it for renewal collateral. Also drafting a runbook for fallback routing to async job queue.
Jorge (CS): Action items: 1) ask customer for sample prompts + artifact (Jorge) 2) security docs (Jorge) 3) safety baseline (Quinn) 4) bench + sizing (Nina + Omar) 5) enablement agenda (Lina).
Nina (Solutions): Once we get the prompt pack I'll run a local bench and post results in this thread. If p95 can't hit 180ms we should propose a mixed-SLA: 85% sync @180ms, rest async.
Jorge (CS): Noted, and I already flagged renewal risk to AE. Leah said renewal discussion in 6 weeks.
infra-bot: Reminder: schedule SOC2 addendum sign-off step in contract process.
Omar (SRE): Heads-up: if they insist on customer-managed on-prem HSM we'll need 4 week lead for ops readiness.
Jorge (CS): Leah prefers cloud HSM; asked to confirm and send artifact. Thanks all :thumbsup:
